detaileddescription.para: This header is a stylistic sample modelled on a mainstream GPU vendor' GXPU runtime (a CUDA-like C API): opaque handles, enumerations, and free functions that return a status code. It is intentionally not a class-based API, mirroring how vendor GPU runtimes are usually exposed in C. The gx prefix and the GX_* enum/constant names are placeholders for this portfolio demo and are unrelated to any shipping product.
Source code stays private (excluded by .gitignore); only this interface contract is published through Doxygen + Breathe. Swap in your real internal headers to document an actual library.
